 For the Petitioner : Mr. Manoj Kumar Sah, Advocate
 For the State : Mr. Sudhir Kumar Mahto, A.P.P.

04/08.08.2025

The petitioner is seeking regular bail in connection with Meharma P
Case No. 106/2024, registered for the offences under Sections 108 and 3(5) of the Bharatiya Nyaya
Sanhita, 2023, pending before the learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Godda.

2.  Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is in custody since 17.05.2025 and prior to lodging of the present case, the grandfather of the victim has lodged the case against the petitioner being Meharma P.S. Case No.94 of 2021 under Sections 366 and 376(2)(n) of the Indian Penal Code and Section 6 of POCSO Act, in which, the petitioner has been acquitted.
He submits that thereafter the present case has been lodged against the petitioner.
He submits that the petitioner has got no role to force the victim to commit suicide.
3. Learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer and submits that the allegations are there that due to his relationship, she has committed suicide.

4. It appears that the petitioner is in custody since 17.05.2025 and in the case registered against the petitioner being Meharma P.S. Case No.94 of 2021, the petitioner has been acquitted and it is not clear how the petitioner was involved in committing suicide by the daughter of the informant.

5. Regard being had to the above facts, I am inclined to enlarge the above-named petitioner, on bail,
on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Godda in connection with Meharma P.S. Case No.106/2024.

(Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J.) Ajay/
